title: Kiyomizu-dera
summary: A hillside temple complex known for its wooden stage and city views.
tip: Arrive early to avoid the densest crowds on the approach streets.

title: Nishiki Market
summary: A lively covered market for snacks, sweets, pickles, and Kyoto specialties.
tip: Go with a short list and share bites so you can sample more stalls.

title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
summary: A dense bamboo path with one of Kyoto’s most iconic walking experiences.
tip: The grove feels most atmospheric just after sunrise before tour groups arrive.

title: Fushimi Inari Taisha
summary: A mountainside shrine route lined with thousands of vermilion torii gates.
tip: If you continue beyond the first viewpoint, the path becomes quieter and more rewarding.

title: Gion Shirakawa
summary: A preserved canal-side district with teahouses, lanterns, and evening atmosphere.
tip: Visit at dusk for the strongest contrast between water reflections and wooden facades.

title: Kinkaku-ji
summary: The Golden Pavilion reflected in a pond, one of Kyoto’s most recognizable scenes.
tip: Cloudy days often produce cleaner water reflections than harsh midday sun.
